decisions.reason: The award-winning organic yogurt on mango puree has demonstrated consumer appeal and fits Söbbeke's core organic dairy line.
Recently launched and featured on the home page, the flavored organic cheese is still being promoted and deserves more time to establish itself.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a staple format in the organic cheese counter business and is unlikely to be dropped quickly.
Spicy cheese is a niche variant with somewhat higher risk, but there is no evidence of poor performance one year after launch.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounded out the new 'Monsieur Jean Bernard' range and supports the product family.
The washed-rind soft cheese has narrower appeal but is part of the new soft cheese range, so the firm would likely give it more time.
